inputs.name: RequestSessionService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Required settings used by the service: a session repository for credential lookups and the configured public origin for unsafe-method same-origin checks.

inputs.name: RequestSessionService.resolve.request
inputs.description: The Fetch request whose authorization or cookie credential and URL path are checked to resolve a live session in scope.

inputs.name: RequestSessionService.browser.request
inputs.description: The Fetch request used to resolve a browser cookie session; an Authorization header is rejected.

inputs.name: RequestSessionService.required.request
inputs.description: The Fetch request whose selected authorization or cookie session must be live and in scope.

inputs.name: RequestSessionService.crossOrigin.request
inputs.description: The Fetch request whose method and origin are checked; GET, HEAD and OPTIONS are always treated as safe.

outputs.name: RequestSessionService.resolve
outputs.description: The live session only when its kind matches the credential channel and its resource covers the request path; otherwise null. Unsafe cross-origin cookie requests resolve to null, and an Authorization header never falls back to cookies.

outputs.name: RequestSessionService.browser
outputs.description: The browser-kind session resolved from the cookie. Authorization requests, unsafe cross-origin requests and requests without a live browser session throw the declared authentication failures.

outputs.name: RequestSessionService.required
outputs.description: The live in-scope session resolved from the selected credential channel. Unsafe cross-origin cookie requests and requests without a live in-scope session throw the declared authentication failures.

outputs.name: RequestSessionService.crossOrigin
outputs.description: True when the request method is not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS and the request is not same-origin with the configured origin; safe methods return false.

errors.name: session-required
errors.description: Thrown when browser() receives an Authorization header or cannot resolve a live browser cookie session, or when required() cannot resolve a live in-scope session.

errors.name: origin-denied
errors.description: Thrown for an unsafe cross-origin request in browser(), or for an unsafe cross-origin cookie request in required().
